map.基于腹部侧位X线平片腹主动脉钙化(AAC)的 Kauppila 评分系统: Based on the Kauppila scoring system for abdominal lateral X-ray aortic calcification (AAC)
map.总分 = L1-L4各节段(前壁+后壁)评分之和: Total score = sum of each L1-L4 segment (anterior + posterior wall) score
map.Kauppila 评分（L1-L4 腹主动脉前壁+后壁）: Kauppila score (L1-L4 abdominal aorta anterior + posterior wall)
map.对每个腰椎水平(L1-L4)的腹主动脉前壁和后壁分别评分：0=无钙化，1=钙化<: Score the anterior and posterior walls of the abdominal aorta at each lumbar level (L1-L4) separately: 0=no calcification, 1=calcification <1/3, 2=calcification 1/3-2/3, 3=calcification >2/3
map.腹主动脉壁无钙化影: No calcification shadow on the abdominal aortic wall
map.钙化覆盖少于该节段血管壁的1/3: Calcification covers less than 1/3 of the segment's vessel wall
map.总分 = L1-L4各节段(前壁+后壁)评分之和，范围0-24分。≥8分提示重度: Total score = sum of each L1-L4 segment (anterior + posterior wall), range 0-24 points. ≥8 points indicates severe vascular calcification.
map.高心血管事件和死亡风险: High cardiovascular event and death risk
map.提示：腹部侧位X线是评估CKD患者血管钙化的简便方法。Kauppila评分≥8分: Note: abdominal lateral X-ray is a simple method to assess vascular calcification in CKD patients. A Kauppila score ≥8 is independently associated with cardiovascular death. Annual vascular calcification assessment is recommended for dialysis patients. Other methods include cardiac CT coronary calcium score (Agatston) and pulse wave velocity (PWV). This tool is for learning reference only.
map.四段各 1.5 分: 1.5 points each for the four segments
map.L1–L4 前/后壁各 0–3 分；示例每段 1.5 合计 6 分→中度钙化。: L1–L4 anterior/posterior walls 0–3 points each; example 1.5 per segment totaling 6 points → moderate calcification.
map.总分接近 24→重度腹主动脉钙化，心血管事件风险高。: Total score close to 24 → severe abdominal aortic calcification, high cardiovascular event risk.
map.腹主动脉 L1–L4 水平前/后壁，各段 0–3 分。: Abdominal aorta L1–L4 level anterior/posterior walls, 0–3 points per segment.
map.钙化积分越高，透析者心血管死亡率越高，指导干预。: The higher the calcification score, the higher the cardiovascular mortality in dialysis patients, guiding intervention.
map.血管钙化(腹部X线)评分器，根据腹部侧位X线平片腹主动脉钙化(AAC)程度进行K: Vascular calcification (abdominal X-ray) scoring tool: performs the Kauppila score from the degree of abdominal aortic calcification (AAC) on abdominal lateral X-ray, assessing vascular calcification burden in CKD patients. A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
